# Agent operating contract

## Where am I?

The root of Pager, a small Python library that splits lists into pages.

## Routing

| Change | Destination | Rule or reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Library code | `src/` | this file |

## How to work

Check a change with `python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import pager; print(pager.page([1, 2, 3], 2))"`.
